routes.alighting: Alight at any listed pier; hop-on hop-off service between Phra Arthit (N13) and Sathorn (Central Pier, CEN); route extended to Asiatique in the evening (official ticketing: after 15:30 onwards from Phra Arthit; official route map: from 12:10).
routes.boarding: Hop on at any listed pier during operating hours; official guidance: arrive at the pier at least 5 minutes before the scheduled departure time (official route map). Sathorn pier connects to BTS Saphan Taksin (S6).

fares.note: All-day River Pass — unlimited hop-on hop-off for the day (official route map)

operatingHours.note: Per official online ticketing: From Sathorn first boat 08:30, last boat 19:15; From Phra Arthit first boat 09:00, last boat 18:30. Boats depart every 30 minutes. The official route-map image gives differing figures (Phra Arthit to Sathorn 08:30-19:00; Sathorn to Phra Arthit 09:00-19:45) — discrepancy noted in coverage.notes.

routes.payment: Tickets sold via the operator's official online ticketing storefront (chaophrayatouristboat-online.globaltix.com, linked from the official homepage); promo codes published on the official storefront (e.g. 2-ticket and 4-for-3 promotions); phone 02-024-1342. Whether tickets can be bought at pier booths or on board was not confirmed on official pages (see coverage.missingFields).

serviceNotices.text: 10월 13일 공휴일은 옐로 낮 시간대 운행표가 적용돼요. 10월 15일 12시 이후에는 일부 구간 운행이 나뉘며, 16일도 별도 시간표가 있어요. 아래 지도는 일반 노선의 정차 목록이므로 해당 날짜에는 운영사 특별 운행표를 확인하세요.
